description: List objects in an Object Storage bucket usable by Cloud Hadoop. Filter with prefix; add delimiter='/' for a directory-style listing (sub-paths are rolled up into commonPrefixList)

delimiter.description: Roll up keys containing this delimiter after the prefix into commonPrefixList (use '/' for directories)

marker.description: List keys after this key (UTF-8 binary order) — for paging

maxKeys.description: Maximum number of objects to return

prefix.description: Return only objects whose key starts with this prefix (e.g. 'test/')

name: ncloud_hadoop_list_objects
